entries.title: Initial build — GSAP scroll experience, NJ firm content, Pages previews
entries.summary: Researched the New Jersey firm (Rumpf Law, P.C., Tuckerton) from official municipal records; built the Tidewater Editorial site with a scroll-locked intro, pinned WebGL hero and dawn-disc handoff, horizontal practice gallery, attorneys, approach, service-area chart, FAQ and contact; added middleware (form + telemetry pipelines, Firebase functions), multi-branch GitHub Pages deploy, CI, and docs.
changes: Pages: home, privacy, legal notices, accessibility, 404, dev track
Zero-dependency build: partials, templating, CSP hash, JSON-LD, env-aware robots/noindex
Motion: intro lock, hero pin + dawn disc, word scrub, line reveals, horizontal spreads, portrait clips, drawn steps, chart draw
WebGL tide-field shader with WebGL1/CSS fallbacks and reduced-motion static frame
Inquiry pipeline (shared schema) + privacy-first telemetry pipeline
Firebase inquiry/collect functions + deny-all Firestore rules
GitHub Pages: main → /, recent branches → /preview/<slug>/, previews.json
Docs: content review, compliance, deployment, Visual Codex entry
Firebase Hosting target with security headers (recommended production host)
open: Repo admin: Settings → Pages → Source gh-pages (one-time)
